style.visual: Warm, dark and glossy. Top down pot macros in steel pots, amber sauce, one side lamp. Best reel (6,981 views, median 222) was one unbroken 16 second macro with one yellow tape label. Gaps: most reels have no hook text, none end on a finished dish reveal.
style.context: Slow cooking as craft. The sofritto series (Hour 1, only 7 hours to go; aromatics merging; the trinity is complete) is a real series. Bio promise: Homemade flavours, done properly. Casual prices.
style.copy: Sensory hook, sharp invitation, standard footer. Warm and unhurried, some Thai lines mixed into English captions. Older captions end with DM or GrabFood link in bio, which is superseded by the order app link. Rules: slash prices only, no percentages, free delivery within 2km*.

proposals.title: The 8 hour sofritto, finished
proposals.visual: One continuous macro of the finished sauce in the pot, wooden spoon lift. Yellow tape label "Worth the wait", top left. Finish on the plated pasta with steam. Crop 4:5 for the grid cover.
proposals.caption: Eight hours of onion, carrot and celery, slowly turning to amber. It becomes the base of every sauce we make. Worth the wait. Order direct, link in the last line.
proposals.borrow: Your own best reel formula (6,981 views)
proposals.avoid: No cuts faster than every 3 seconds

proposals.title: Red Wine Beef Stew, cooler evenings
proposals.visual: Top down on the stew bowl, one side lamp, dark table. Dish name and components only on the cover.
proposals.caption: Red Wine Beef Stew. AU beef, red wine, carrot, a gravy that coats the spoon. Cooler nights call for something slow. Order 2 days ahead, link in the last line.
proposals.avoid: No hard sell, no price in the caption

proposals.title: Lamb shank, Hour 1 of 4 (tease)
proposals.hook: Hour 1 of 4. The shanks meet the pot.
proposals.visual: Top down on the pot. Yellow tape label "Hour 1 of 4". Clip 1: shanks searing, deep brown. Clip 2: onion and garlic dropping in. Only 6 shanks in this batch, say so on screen at the end.
proposals.caption: Hour 1 of 4. A new slow braise is starting in our kitchen. One pot, 6 shanks, and when they are gone they are gone. More soon. Follow along.
proposals.avoid: No order link until the lamb can be ordered

proposals.title: Why we brown first
proposals.visual: Close on meat hitting the oil, then the dark crust lifting with water. Tape label "Brown first". Two clips of 4s, one reveal of 4s.
proposals.caption: The dark crust on the pan is flavour. We lift every bit of it into the braise. That is the difference between a stew and a good stew. Order direct, link in the last line.
proposals.avoid: Share the idea, not the full recipe

proposals.title: Slow Braised Lamb Shank (reveal)
proposals.visual: One hero shot at 45 degrees, steam rising, shank on a dark plate with carrots and gravy. Title card in warm amber, then no other text. One spoon lift to finish. Post only once lamb is orderable in the order app, and shift the date to match.
proposals.caption: Slow Braised Lamb Shank. 1 shank, sweet carrots, 300g of gravy. Falling off the bone, ready to heat. Order 2 days ahead, link in the last line.
proposals.borrow: @jose.kallioinen title card, @bshnuez dish name plus components
proposals.avoid: Do not post before the lamb is orderable
